title: Why Colours Change When You Stare at a Spot
hook: Colours disappear and change just by staring at a dot.

narration.text: Stare at the central red dot in this image, and the colours around it will vanish.
This happens because your brain prioritises new visual information.
When you focus on one spot, your eyes make tiny, unconscious movements.
But the colours in your peripheral vision stay fixed, providing no new input.
Your brain then filters out this unchanging information, making the colours fade.
It is a trick your own mind plays to help you focus on what is important.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you in the comments. Like this if it surprised you and subscribe for more brain hacks.

description: Have you ever noticed colours seemingly disappear when you stare at a central point? This video explains the fascinating reason behind this visual phenomenon. It is all about how your brain processes unchanging information in your peripheral vision.
topic: Why you sometimes see colours change or disappear when staring at a central point. You can test this right now with a simple dot pattern.
